tbesh_html:
1) place or means of safety, protection, refuge, stronghold
1a) place of safety, fastness, harbour, stronghold
1b) refuge (of God) (fig.)
1c) human protection (fig.)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
strongs_1890.derivation: (also מָעוּז ); or מָעֹז (also מָעֻז; from H5810 (עָזַז);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), ([idiom] most) strong (hold).
